name: Kunwar Abhishek Singh
tagline: Satellite remote sensing, artificial intelligence, and data-driven methods for understanding and forecasting water quality.
bio_short: I am a joint PhD graduate of IIT Kharagpur and the University of Melbourne through the Melbourne India Postgraduate Academy (MIPA). My research brings together Earth observation, machine learning, and hydroclimatic information to monitor and forecast river water quality, particularly in data-scarce and ungauged environments.
bio_long: My research is driven by a simple question: how can we make reliable environmental information available where in-situ monitoring is limited? During my joint PhD at IIT Kharagpur and the University of Melbourne, I developed methods that combine satellite observations, machine learning, and hydroclimatic data to retrieve, estimate, and forecast river water-quality parameters. I am particularly interested in multispectral and hyperspectral remote sensing, AI-enabled environmental analysis, and practical methods that can inform decisions for river systems and aquatic ecosystems. Looking ahead, I aim to extend this work toward integrated water quantity–quality assessment and scalable approaches for environmental monitoring.
current_title: Remote Sensing & AI Researcher | Water Resources and Environmental Monitoring
seo_description: Academic portfolio of Kunwar Abhishek Singh, PhD. Research in optical remote sensing, satellite-based river water quality monitoring, machine learning and seasonal forecasting.
collaboration_message: Interested in collaborating on Earth observation, river water quality, hydroinformatics or AI for environmental sustainability? I would be glad to connect.
